users.//: Who is an admin. Keyed by auth uid because that is what these rules can check — the staff directory is matched separately, by email. Written only by the server (Admin SDK, where configured) or an existing admin, so nobody can promote themselves.

staff.//: Public read so the unauthenticated door tablet can list who is in the office. Admins only for writes. Never put anything private in this node.

visitor_requests.//: An admin may read the whole log. Everyone else may only run a query constrained to their own address — an unconstrained read from a non-admin is refused, so one staff member cannot see who visited another.

$requestId.//: The kiosk is anonymous: it may create a request and read back the single push id it just created, but never edit one. Staff may respond to their own; admins to any.

calendar_events.//: This app's own calendar for each staff member — full detail (titles, locations). Readable and writable only by that person (matched by email against their staff record) or an admin. The kiosk never reads this node; it only ever sees busy_blocks below.

busy_blocks.//: Public mirror of calendar_events carrying only start/end — never a title. This is what the door tablet reads to show when someone is free, without ever being able to see what their meetings are about.

$other.//: Nothing else in this database is readable or writable.
